description:
Declare priority through the vocabulary macro and delete each restated priority token.

## Background

Priority tokens are restated by `priority_str` (`crates/jit/src/commands/graph.rs:64-71`), used for `BatchIssueDef.priority: Option<String>` (`:372`), by a hand-written list in `schema.rs:780`, and by the query language's `PRIORITY_VALUES` (`query_engine/error.rs`). `Priority::from_str` folds case (`domain/types.rs:192`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Priority` is declared through the macro, and its parser accepts exact tokens only.
- [hard] REQ-02: `priority_str` and the hand-written schema list are gone, and `BatchIssueDef.priority` is typed.
- [hard] REQ-03: The query language's priority value list derives from the enum.
title: Priority tokens come from one declaration
